title: Enterprise Decision Schema
description: Canonical representation of a decision point within an enterprise business process.

decision_description.description: Additional explanation of the decision point.

decision_question.description: Business question that must be answered at the decision point.

incoming_activity.description: Identifier of the activity immediately preceding this decision.

outgoing_paths.description: Possible outcomes and routing paths from the decision.

condition.description: Condition that determines whether this path is taken.

next_activity.description: Identifier of the next activity if the condition is satisfied.

business_rule_id.description: Business rule governing this routing decision.

default_path.description: Fallback activity if no decision condition matches.

business_rule_ids.description: Business rules referenced by this decision.

decision_owner.description: Business owner responsible for this decision.

decision_criteria.description: Criteria used when evaluating the decision.

supporting_systems.description: Systems that assist in evaluating or executing the decision.

risk_level.description: Business risk associated with the decision.

automation_candidate.description: Indicates whether the decision is a candidate for automation.

escalation_path.description: Escalation route when the decision cannot be completed.

sla.description: Expected service level or turnaround time for completing the decision.
